title: Data Entry and MIS Analyst
description:
**JOB PURPOSE**

The Data Entry & MIS Analyst will support GEM Drytech's Sales, Marketing, and Management teams by researching, extracting, validating, organizing, analyzing, and maintaining high-quality prospect and business data.

The role will also be responsible for preparing and maintaining accurate **MIS reports, dashboards, trackers, sales reports, lead-generation reports, campaign reports, and management summaries** to support better business decision-making.

The position combines data management, online research, MIS reporting, AI-enabled productivity tools, client communication support, and structured outbound communication through email, WhatsApp, and CRM-based follow-up to improve lead-generation efficiency for industrial drying and process-equipment markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Research and identify relevant companies, industries, decision-makers, and contact persons using LinkedIn, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, company websites, online directories, search engines, AI research tools, and approved databases.

· Extract and maintain structured prospect data including company name, contact person, designation, location, industry, email ID, phone/WhatsApp number, LinkedIn profile, website, application, lead source, and other relevant sales intelligence.

· Source and verify business email IDs and contact information through approved tools such as Apollo, Snov.io, Skrapp, Hunter, LinkedIn, and manual web research, with strong emphasis on accuracy and data validity.

· Enter, update, validate, clean, and maintain prospect and client data in MS Excel, Google Sheets, CRM/ERP systems, internal trackers, and campaign databases.

· Perform duplicate removal, formatting, data cleansing, bounced-email cleanup, invalid-contact identification, and periodic database hygiene to maintain usable and reliable lead lists.

· Prepare and maintain **daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports** for Sales, Marketing, Lead Generation, Outreach, CRM activities, and other assigned business functions.

· Develop and maintain **Excel/Google Sheets dashboards, trackers, pivot tables, summary reports, lead-source reports, salesperson-wise reports, campaign-performance reports, and management MIS**.

· Consolidate data from multiple sources and prepare accurate management reports showing targets vs achievements, pending activities, lead status, outreach performance, conversion status, and other defined KPIs.

· Use formulas including **VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF, COUNTIF/COUNTIFS, SUMIF/SUMIFS, Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, data validation, filters, and other Excel functions** required for MIS preparation and data analysis.

· Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, missing entries, unusual variances, duplicate records, and reporting errors and coordinate with responsible teams for correction.

· Maintain standardized reporting formats, naming conventions, master databases, MIS templates, and management trackers.

· Use AI-enabled research and productivity tools to accelerate company research, prospect classification, data enrichment, contact prioritization, spreadsheet analysis, reporting, and preparation of structured summaries while ensuring human verification before final use.

· Support outbound email campaigns by preparing clean contact lists, applying approved templates, personalizing basic fields, scheduling or sending approved campaigns, and recording outreach status in CRM/trackers.

· Support WhatsApp outreach using approved templates and contact lists, and coordinate responses or qualified interest with the responsible Sales Executive / Sales Manager.

· Handle professional email correspondence with prospects or clients for basic information, acknowledgements, follow-up, document sharing, and coordination within approved communication templates and escalation guidelines.

· Coordinate with Sales and Marketing teams to understand target industries, geographies, customer profiles, priority applications, campaign requirements, reporting requirements, and management KPIs before starting research or outreach activities.

· Maintain accurate CRM/MIS records for new contacts, outreach attempts, responses, follow-ups, lead status, source, campaign, assigned salesperson, and opportunity progression.

· Prepare daily and weekly activity reports covering contacts researched, valid emails sourced, data uploaded, emails/WhatsApp messages sent, responses received, invalid data removed, CRM updates, pending actions, and team performance where applicable.

· Support Management with ad-hoc MIS reports, data analysis, database summaries, comparison reports, and information required for business reviews and decision-making.

· Protect company databases, prospect information, client records, campaign lists, MIS reports, credentials, and confidential business data in accordance with company policy.

· Meet defined productivity and quality KPIs, including approximately **25–30 researched leads per working day, 100–150 valid prospect records per week, 80%+ verified email availability where applicable, 60–100 approved emails per day / 300+ per week, 50–100 WhatsApp outreach messages per week, 100% timely CRM/MIS updates, and weekly data cleanup.**

**Mandatory Requirements**

· 1–2 years of experience in **MIS, data research, data management, lead generation, sales support, client service, back-office operations, reporting, outreach, or related roles**. Strong freshers with relevant MIS and tool exposure may also be considered.

· Strong working knowledge of **MS Excel and Google Sheets**, including formatting, sorting, filtering, duplicate removal, data validation, conditional formatting, basic and intermediate formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF formulas, COUNTIF/COUNTIFS, SUMIF/SUMIFS, Pivot Tables, and structured data handling.

· Practical knowledge of **MIS reporting**, including preparation of daily, weekly, and monthly reports, management trackers, KPI reports, dashboards, target-vs-achievement reports, and summary reports.

· Ability to consolidate data from different Excel sheets, Google Sheets, CRM systems, and internal databases and convert the data into structured management reports.

· Good internet research capability and the ability to identify correct companies, relevant decision-makers, business roles, and credible contact information from multiple sources.

· Working familiarity with LinkedIn and online research. Ability to learn or use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Snov.io, Skrapp, Hunter, mail-merge tools, or similar lead-research platforms.

· Good written English and professional email communication skills, with the ability to write clear, concise, and grammatically correct business correspondence.

· High attention to detail, numerical accuracy, data consistency, confidentiality, and the ability to work with large volumes of repetitive information without compromising quality.

· Ability to follow SOPs, templates, MIS formats, naming conventions, campaign instructions, reporting timelines, and daily/weekly targets with disciplined execution and minimal supervision.

· Working knowledge of MS Word, PowerPoint, Outlook/Gmail, PDF handling, file management, and basic CRM or sales-tracking systems.

· Ability to work independently as well as coordinate effectively with Marketing, Sales, Management, Accounts, HR, or other departments where MIS information is required.

**Preferred Requirements**

· Previous experience in B2B lead generation, MIS reporting, industrial / engineering / manufacturing companies, technical sales support, export marketing, or capital-goods businesses will be preferred.

· Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Snov.io, Skrapp, Hunter, Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Smartlead, Mailchimp, Gmail mail merge, or similar research/outreach platforms will be an advantage.

· Strong practical experience in **Advanced Excel, Pivot Tables, data analysis, MIS dashboards, Power Query, charts, automated reports, or Google Sheets reporting** will be an advantage.

· Experience researching international markets, identifying decision-makers across multiple countries, and working with export-oriented prospect databases will be preferred.

· Familiarity with AI tools for research, data enrichment, summarization, classification, spreadsheet assistance, MIS preparation, and productivity improvement, with the ability to verify AI-generated information before use.

· Basic understanding of sales funnels, lead qualification, email deliverability, bounced-email management, campaign lists, CRM stages, follow-up workflows, and sales performance reporting is desirable.

· Experience handling client email correspondence or customer-service coordination and maintaining professional communication standards will be an advantage.

· Ability to prepare **management-ready Excel MIS reports, pivot tables, dashboards, lead-source summaries, salesperson-wise performance reports, outreach reports, campaign reports, and KPI trackers** will be strongly preferred.

**Qualifications**

· Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university / institute. **B.Com, BBA, BCA, B.Sc., BA, or equivalent qualification** is acceptable.

· Qualification or certification in **Computer Applications, Advanced Excel, MIS, Data Analytics, Digital Marketing, CRM, AI productivity tools, or related areas** will be an added advantage.

· Candidates should demonstrate strong computer literacy, MIS reporting capability, internet research ability, numerical accuracy, business communication skills, and comfort working with structured data and outreach tools.

· 1–2 years of relevant experience is preferred. Candidates with demonstrated practical capability in **MIS reporting, Advanced Excel, data research, lead generation, CRM/data handling, dashboards, or outreach** may also be considered.

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: Reporting and Data Analyst
description:
**Description**
---------------

**About WTW**  
Willis Towers Watson (NASDAQ: WLTW) is a leading global advisory, broking and solutions company that helps clients around the world turn risk into a path for growth. With roots dating to 1828, Willis Towers Watson has 45,000 employees serving more than 140 countries and markets.  
We design and deliver solutions that manage risk, optimize benefits, cultivate talent, and expand the power of capital to protect and strengthen institutions and individuals. Our unique perspective allows us to see the critical intersections between talent, assets and ideas — the dynamic formula that drives business performance.  
Together, we unlock potential.

  

**About the Role:** The Reporting and Data Analyst is responsible for delivering data-driven insights and reporting solutions to support stakeholders across the organisation. The role focuses on designing, building and maintaining scalable datasets, data models and data transformation processes that enable effective operational reporting and analytics. The associate will collaborate closely with business partners and work with modern analytics platforms such as Databricks, while contributing to the continued development and evolution of the organisation’s analytics ecosystem.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with stakeholders across various departments to understand reporting requirements and translate them into meaningful analytics solutions.
* Use SQL to extract, analyze, transform, and manipulate data, with a focus on key performance indicators and business metrics.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data models and curated datasets that support operational reporting and analytics.
* Leverage Databricks and cloud-based analytics platforms to develop, maintain, and optimize data transformation and analytics workflows.
* Support the development of scalable data architectures, reusable data pipelines, and curated datasets that enable reliable operational reporting and analytics.
* Contribute to the design and evolution of data models and analytics solutions that improve the accessibility, reliability, and usability of data across the organization.
* Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI or similar visualization tools to monitor performance and identify trends.
* Conduct ad hoc analysis to address business questions and support strategic initiatives.
* Advance data quality, accuracy, accessibility, and governance through validation, monitoring, documentation, and continuous improvement practices.
* Support and maintain business-critical reporting solutions while identifying opportunities for automation and modernization.
* Create and maintain technical and process documentation for datasets, data pipelines, reporting solutions, and business processes.
* Evaluate and leverage emerging analytics and AI-enabled technologies to improve data accessibility, accelerate development, and enhance reporting and analytical capabilities.
* Provide support and training to end users on accessing and interpreting reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Business acumen related to benefits, funding, insurance, and/or phone operations.
* 2+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, or a related analytics role.
* Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and manipulation.
* Experience working with relational databases and complex datasets.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand and interpret complex data.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and effectively engage stakeholders at all levels.
* Detail-oriented, with a commitment to producing accurate and reliable reporting and analysis.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Databricks or a comparable modern cloud-based analytics platform.
* Experience developing and maintaining data models, reporting datasets, data pipelines, and transformation processes.
* Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and data architecture principles.
* Experience with Python, Spark, or similar data processing technologies.
* Experience with Power BI or similar business intelligence and visualization tools.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity, analytics, and development tools and an interest in leveraging emerging technologies to improve efficiency, accelerate analysis, and enhance reporting solutions.

  

**The Application Process**

  

* Stage 1: Online application and recruiter review
* Stage 2: Pre-recorded video interview
* Stage 3: Live video or in person interview with hiring manager and team
* Stage 4: Offer and onboarding
